project_name: MARA Hannibal / Long Ridge digital infrastructure campus
aliases: Long Ridge Energy Terminal data center campus
status_detail: MARA announced an agreement on 2026-04-30 to acquire Long Ridge Energy & Power in Hannibal, including a 505 MW gas plant and 1,600 acres. MARA says the site includes 200 MW of existing capacity and a path to up to 600 gross MW of AI/Critical IT load, with initial AI/Critical IT buildout expected to begin in 1H 2027 and service targeted for mid-2028.
notes: County economic development context from OhioSE confirms the Hannibal/Long Ridge property has been marketed as a data center campus; Athens County Independent quotes Monroe County economic development director Jason Hamman saying he is not aware of a new data center under construction, so status is planned rather than construction.

project_name: Bitdeer Clarington / Hannibal Industrial Park data center
aliases: Erie Creek LLC lease at Hannibal Industrial Park
developer: Bitdeer Technologies Group / Erie Creek LLC
status_detail: Bitdeer lists Clarington, Ohio as an in-progress 570 MW colocation pipeline site with power under contract; February 2026 update notes ongoing legal proceedings may affect timing. SEC-filed lease documents show Erie Creek LLC leasing premises from the Monroe County Port Authority at 42722 OH-7, Clarington, Ohio.
notes: Bitdeer source calls the usage colocation and references AI/HPC strategy; lease counterparty is Erie Creek LLC and public filing places the project in Ohio Township, Monroe County.

project_name: DP Facilities Hannibal data center campus
status_detail: 2019-2021 announcements described a DP Facilities data center campus next to the Long Ridge power plant and Ohio Tax Credit Authority approval for a 75%, 10-year data center sales tax exemption, with Long Ridge offering more than 200 MW for hyperscale and blockchain development. Later local reporting says Monroe County's economic development director stated the DP Facilities project did not come to fruition.
notes: Kept as historical/possibly superseded lead because official OhioSE and DP Facilities pages documented the project; current status appears inactive or superseded by later MARA/Bitdeer activity.

status_detail: Public data-center tracker lists Stratacache as an operational data center at 4646 Needmore Rd, Dayton, Montgomery County, with 2.4 MW power capacity; Dayton Business Journal reporting in 2016 described Stratacache plans for a new data center after purchasing the Needmore Road property.

project_name: Cipher Digital Center Township data center
status_detail: Athens County Independent reports Cipher Digital, a hyperscale data center developer/operator, announced plans in July 2026 to build a data center in Center Township and held a June 17 public meeting at Morgan High School. County Commissioner Steve Best said the project may provide about 50 long-term jobs and 1,500 phased construction jobs, with no abatement determined and possible TIF discussions.
notes: Developer had not released full acreage, power or water details as of the cited reporting; local newspaper/Facebook items corroborate a public meeting but much detail remains pending.
